reviews.title: Appalling customer service
reviews.text: Flight delayed at 6.30 then cancelled. Left at airport with no information until 9.30pm with no food or drink available. No communication for alternate travel times following day. On enquiry found flight to depart 2pm- subsequently delayed until 3pm then again to 5pm. Still waiting Regular scheduled flight came and went today with other passengers with no consideration for existing inconvenienced passengers from day before. No offer of anything to compensate for inconvenience - not even a coffee. I’d even hesitate to use Link again even if they offered free flight
reviews.author: rosella

reviews.title: Fierce Brisbane check in
reviews.text: Fierce Brisbane check in staff member who terrified my child, charged us extra for luggage and the "logic" she used to weigh hand luggage of his and not mine didn't make sense. Was glad to get to Dubbo quickly but won't be using them again anytime soon. Received a far superior experience for less than half the price and with many more smiles the following day on another small airline.
reviews.author: Emi

reviews.title: Delayed for hours , poor communication, did not end up flying
reviews.text: Flight was to leave at 1110. Initially told 30 mins delay. At 1pm staff said the engineers will call back within the next hour. At 5pm, staff said it was unlikely to leave due to crew rest requirements. Staff advised that there were Qantas flights leaving the next day - for which passengers would be required to pay for their own tickets. Nil provisions were made for accomodation overnight . Do not recommend this airline
reviews.author: Justine M

reviews.title: Loved the old fashioned service with a smile
reviews.text: From the lady onboarding me at the airline remembering my name to getting back home and having a chat with the guy in front who was flying for his first time , the whole atmosphere was happy relaxed and friendly. The ease of check in the lovely hostess who I got both times always smiling and professional the complimentary drinks and snacks (not having to rummage for change or a card is so good ) and the final touch of a lolly for landing was perfect. Will most definitely be flying with your team again
reviews.author: Nicola B

reviews.title: Plane M.I.A.
reviews.text: Our 14yo flight to his grandparents, Well flight departure time of 430pm. Our son was taken to the plane, about 20 mins later taken off the plane. Called us to inform he had been taken off plane. Advised about 530pm he was going back on plane but his phone was dying, received text msg 540pm stating new departure time of 545pm. Grandparents at Coffs Harbour waiting when all the lights go out, They go and ask what is happening regarding the flight: advised that the flight had to fo straight to Armidale due to needing to drop something off. I called Link after hours like to be advised that the plane left at 545pm but didn't seem to know what she was talking about. Checked Brisbane airport website stated flight left at 615pm. Called Armidale airport to be told plane was ment to land 530pm. Well this was 7pm at this stage. After awhile was able to find the plane on flightraidr app under to call sign or any info. This is a great way to stress a bunch of people out unnecessarily due to lack of info and lack of communication. Don't believe we will be using this airline again. Because we really don't need planes just being MIA.
reviews.author: Corey L

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly staff that love their job, plane from Tamworth to Brisbane was very small and little dirty , but very nice staff..the pilots were the staff, once in the air there is no customer service. Pickup some food and water on the way to your seat. Also pretty noisy. But so pleased I got to Brisbane for a pretty good price. From Brisbane to Tamworth the plane was a bit bigger and also had staff to help throughout the flight and was a lot cleaner. Bring your own entertainment if needed. Got food and drink and well looked after throughout the second flight. Anyway thankyou for getting me to QLD to see my sister.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.title: Calm, convenient and comfortable
reviews.text: Easy everything, from purchasing the ticket online, online checking, helpful staff, good food service and comfortable flight. But best of all, direct flight to Hobart from Canberra under 2 hours. Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Russelljack

reviews.title: Good services from Newcastel to Canberra - easy as
reviews.text: I have flown a few times to NTL/CBR and return via Link. Other that an issue with getting the checkin started at Newcastle (there is always a comms issue) the staff are helpfull and friendly, the flight smooth and uneventful. A good, reliable service. The timnes of the flights allow a good business days work to be done.
reviews.author: davide61

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Flight left on time and made the horrendous nearly 6 hr car journey from Canberra to Newcastle and absolute pleasure. In the air for only 45 mins. The flight attendant was so friendly. He handed out cheese and crackers, nuts, chips and free beer. Don't get that on Rex. The Saab 340 is a bit noisy but it's pretty comfortable otherwise. Link is my new favourite regional airline!
reviews.author: Ben Sangster

reviews.title: Handy direct flight but not the best
reviews.text: You think when paying $351 for a flight, they could provide a facemask like Qantas or Virgin do. Other than that flight was convenient and arrived on time, struggled to sleep on the plane due to comfort but other than that a fine trip
reviews.author: Bernie Young

reviews.title: Great Flight
reviews.text: Travelled to visit family in Dubbo and from making the booking to the friendly flight crew this airline was wonderful. The hostess Katherine was on both flights and was warm and friendly and it was easy to tell she enjoyed her job and she showed a true genuine interest in the passengers. Flights were punctual and the plane was comfortable and modern. The onboard snacks were plentiful and appreciated. Will fly with Link again.
reviews.author: Etsa S

reviews.title: A great new Airline with fantastic service
reviews.text: What a breath of fresh air. Fantastic helpful staff, comfortable seating and free in flight service plus the best views of the East Coast. I will be using Link for all my future travel to Wollongong. Well done!
reviews.author: Michael W

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Great service! Love being able to fly from Tamworth to Brisbane! Staff and service are excellent! If you are able to nab one of the cheaper fares then it is great value.
reviews.author: jen c

reviews.title: Awesome Link Airways
reviews.text: Brilliant trip thankyou Link (Im a nervous flyer). Super clean aircraft, great staff (def take noise cancelling headphones). Will be booking again!!!
reviews.author: RedShingle

reviews.title: Brilliant experience!!
reviews.text: Fabulous on-time return flights BNE to WLG. I cannot fault the entire experience from departure to arrival. The booking and check-in process is easy. Not having to pay extra for exit seats is great. Plenty of leg room (I'm 6'2) and the seats are comfortable. The staff are all exceptionally professional, super friendly and an absolute delight to talk to. Snacks are spot on - packet of nuts, biscuits and cheese and crackers. Hot and cold beverages free flowing. Alcoholic drinks also served on the evening flight. The pilot greeting you at the foot of the stairs when disembarking is a lovely touch. On arrival to Wollongong (Shellharbour) we landed and I was in the car leaving the airport within 10 minutes. I have been singing the praises of Link to everyone!
reviews.author: MelNicole14

reviews.title: An Enjoyable Flight on The Great Metroliner!
reviews.text: I'm a bit of a plane spotter and aviation geek, and I wanted to fly on a Metroliner as there aren't many airlines flying them anymore. I went from Brisbane to Biloela/Thangool Airport. Was originally going to travel Armidale to Brisbane but due to NSW Border I changed to just stay within QLD and Biloela/Thangool was the only flight within QLD that Link had. Link let me change for free and just pay fare/tax difference. Check In area for Link at Brisbane Airport was behind Jetstar, as it's a small plane luggage is 15 kilos and carry on is 7 kilos and my carry on was weighed. You can pay extra for another checked in bag or pay per extra kilo if your checked in bag is over 15 kilos. Check In was quick, boarding was quick and when boarding the plane everyone was offered a bottle of cold water and a snack, I wasn't hungry so I didn't take a snack. We were delayed by around an hour due to a jam with the luggage area at BNE. We ended up leaving without a bag but thankfully it wasn't mine. The missing bag wasn't Link's fault and they said the bag would go to Rockhampton then bus to Biloela so the passenger who didn't get their bag would get it that night. Flight time was around an hour. Overall flight was very smooth and pilot and co pilot was very pilot and get up updated during the delay. Head room is tight when boarding and leaving the plane but when sitting down it is fine. We need more Australian's to support small airlines!
reviews.author: WilliamB

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: Flight FC 201 Canberra to Newcastle and return flight FC 208. Easy booking online with e-ticket. Friendly professional service. Reasonable cost. SAAB 340 Turboprop plane with c. 34 seats. Generous with snacks (cheese & crackers, mixed nuts, 3 choices of flavoured crisps, wine, soft drinks, juice, etc.). Start with a small bottle of water, end trip with a 'landing lolly' (fantails, mints); and happy to offer wine top-ups during the trips. Very attentive and helpful flight steward on first flight who gives the airline a special touch. A bit less so the two stewards on the return flight who seemed to favour one couple a little more (seems to happen on most airlines). Free face masks were not available at the Newcastle airport flight gate counter as they were at the Canberra gate (even though reminder email from airline mentioned masks would be available). Was okay for me as I carried my own masks. Overall very enjoyable and relaxed flights (even with a bit of air turbulence which was well handled). Highly recommend this airline. And this particular route enabled me to bypass greater Sydney with its current COVID-19 outbreaks. Happy New Year.
reviews.author: Wingecarribee

reviews.title: amazing service, really impressed
reviews.text: I recently flew with Link Airways (formerly Fly Corporate) from Wollongong/Shellharbour airport to Brisbane. I found everything about the service was excellent. The jet seated about 30 people and I hate flying on small aircraft, and in fact actively avoid them, but this one was big enough for me to feel comfortable and safe on and it's basically a jet with 2 engines so all good. From booking, check in, seat selection, to the actual service itself, I cannot fault them. I got a really cheap ticket to boot. The stewardess Jess was a delight and the mid afternoon on board snacks were really varied and nice. I will not hesitate to fly with Link again.
reviews.author: Poniesnpuppies

reviews.title: Brilliant Customer Service
reviews.text: Even though they must be getting smashed with Corona Virus, every time I interact with Fly Corporate, they exceed my expectations, such good customer service.
reviews.author: Tom B

reviews.title: 10 out of 10 in every department
reviews.text: I just loved the flight from Albion Park to Melbourne. Having flown with Fly Corporate twice, the whole experience of flying to Melbourne from the South Coast has been transformed from an ordeal to a pleasant journey with the arrival of Fly Corporate in the Illawarra. Everything from arrival at the airport, free long term parking, friendly, approachable, efficient staff was a breath of fresh air. Essendon airport is closer to Melbourne CBD than Tullamarine so even the arrival in Melbourne was more straightforward. Necessary changes to the flight times due to the corona crisis were dealt with in the most flexible and considerate manner. I cannot recommend Fly Corporate highly enough for providing a much needed flight service at competitive prices to the Illawarra region.
reviews.author: Missfussypants

reviews.title: Good service. On time. Reasonably priced parking
reviews.text: Great way to go directly to Orange NSW from Melbourne. Friendly check-in staff. No in flight entertainment just jokes from the great flight attendant. Parking is much cheaper than Melbourne Tullamarine. Small plane but nice views and much better than going via Sydney.
reviews.author: Crimitorii

reviews.title: Easy Regional Flight
reviews.text: Nice easy trip for those who get access to the airport at Albion Park Rail. On time, great access to the airport with free parking and 30kg baggage allowance. Much better than going up to Mascot even though it is more expense.
reviews.author: mandrake51

reviews.title: Dependable, friendly and usually on time.
reviews.text: Would always recommend and fly with Fly Corporate as they have been on time every time I have flown with them. The ground staff and pilots are friendly, courteous, and really helpful especially for older people. Although the planes are small passengers feel safe and comfortable. There are no overhead lockers on our route so carry on luggage must be kept to a minimum for your own leg comfort. Water and a snack are offered as you enter the plane as the Co-pilot greets you and gives the safety lecture.
reviews.author: Ailsa H

reviews.title: Great way to Fly
reviews.text: Just had a few days away to Melbourne with friends loved our flight both ways ,all staff were very friendly and helpful especially Tracey Lee,would highly recommend Fly Corporate. So much easier than travelling to Sydney . Wouldnt hesitate to fly with them again . Looking forward to my next flight.
reviews.author: ezi9

reviews.title: good flight and good service
reviews.text: overall good experience. good service.however the flight was 3 hours delayed was not informed until 25 mins before the original departure time.
reviews.author: Shaminka J

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Most convenient for those living in the Illawarra or south of Sydney. Friendly and helpful staff especially Tracy Lee flight attendant. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Toni P

reviews.title: Old fashioned service with new fashioned efficiency
reviews.text: An exceptional and relaxing experience from start to finish. Essendon airport offers long stay parking pretty much at the front doors of the airport for just $8 per day. Corporate staff are friendly, informal and incredibly efficient. From ground staff to pilots to flight attendants they are helpful, pleasant and kind. It felt like going back in time to a friendlier, more personal service. The flight attendant remembered everyone's name and addressed them as he served drinks and snacks - always with a smile and genuine engagement. I cannot remember enjoying a flight more. Fly Corporate fly to multiple locations and from now on, I will be seeking them out before any of the majors. A truly delightful flying experience.
reviews.author: Katrina C

reviews.title: Excellent flight
reviews.text: This was the best experience I have had flying. Traci-Lee was our flight attendant and she was delightful! She looked after every single person that flight with such dedication. What a credit she is to this company. This year I’ve flown to Rome and London and this was streets ahead. So convenient and the price was sensational! I look forward to using this service in the future.
reviews.author: astina31

reviews.title: Fly Corporate - A Tremendous Experience with Great Personal Service
reviews.text: As part of our 30th anniversary itinerary, we planned to travel from Wollongong to Seaford, Victoria to see our Aunt, cousins and their lovely families. Options were to drive, return to Sydney and fly, or take the train. By chance I looked on line and found the option to fly with a smaller airline from Wollongong (Albion Park) to the airfield at Essendon. We were not disappointed. A short cab ride from our hotel and we were at the small but welcoming office from where we departed. Staff were very friendly and welcoming. Tony, originally from Salisbury and ex-Bath rugby, shared an insight into the business and extended our welcome. Boarding the small plane was slick, comfortable and a fabulous experience and way to fly over NSW into Victoria. Less than 30 people on board, Sharon our Cabin Service Supervisor, gave us the highest level of service and friendliness you could ask for. We landed on time and were quick to receive our bags and out of the airport with our relative, Wayne. Wayne lives very close but wasn't aware of this great service from this airport. We are travelling back to Wollongong later and looking forward to the return leg with this fine company and their staff.
reviews.author: HMaxwellFIIRSM

reviews.title: First time with fly corporate
reviews.text: Flight was comfortable, good leg room ( 170cm person) plenty of snacks on offer, flight attendant brilliant (John). Left on time and arrived on time. Definitely recommend
reviews.author: Michele M

reviews.title: Pelican flight
reviews.text: Flights were good for the small size of the plane. The pilots on both trip knew their stuff. Very small on leg room though
reviews.author: Rick63AU

reviews.title: Fun flight
reviews.text: From the getgo in Dubbo we were looked after. Our friendly host, John looked after better than we looked after our only international business class flight. The plane stops in Orange (the only negative part of the flight) and the first bit is only about 20 minutes but in that time we were given a snack and some water. After we left Orange John annonced it was happy hour and the fun commenced. Name your poison - soft drinks but more importantly, beer and good quality wine accompanied by cheese and biscuits, salami sticks and chips. We had our glasses topped up several times and the flight to Essendon was over. Thanks again, we will be back!
reviews.author: themudgeerambler

reviews.title: Great quick flight to Brisbane
reviews.text: Great care and consideration from staff. The plane is small for my stature (6'2") but the ride was great. Looking forward to more flight options in the future.
reviews.author: kjs1988

reviews.title: the best flight
reviews.text: best short flight in my life! Forget the commute to sydney airport, the traffic the parking fee, the waiting! I left my house 40 minutes before the departure time, and parked for free at the airport! The price of the flight was just about the same of other cheap airlines and way cheaper than quantas. The service in the airplane was outstanding, best flight attendants, friendly and extremely professional. Highly reccomend fly corporate and will use at any chance.
reviews.author: monica

reviews.title: Without doubt, the best regional Airline in Aus.
reviews.text: Have flown with these guys four times now, in a short period - Shellharbour (NOT WOLLONGONG) to Brisbane, and also to melbourne. Checkin Staff are extremely helpful, even assisting to take lot of luggage - as need to take exhibition material to Melbourne. Everything is 'no problem' the majors need to learn from these guys. Also the Steward 'John' is an amazing gent, takes his time to have a chat with everyone. Well done FC !!!
reviews.author: christopher b

reviews.title: A better choice
reviews.text: Loved flying with this regional airline - professional and friendly and the big airlines could learn how to treat passengers as people rather than numbers. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret W

reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Flew to Melbourne from Albion Park & return with Fly Corporate what an excellent service. Friendly staff,hassle free & so easy. We only live 7 kilometres from airport so no lengthy drive to Sydney with heaps of traffic, pay for parking for 5 days which adds up. Will definatly use it again.
reviews.author: Kym

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Travelled from Melbourne to Orange return. The staff were amazing. The air hostess Vicki was amazing. Alk the staff took interest in serving. I am very impressed as I travel a lot for work.
reviews.author: SandraFuller

reviews.title: Flying Corporate
reviews.text: A weekend in Melbourne from Orange is so easy. Fly Corporate on Friday morning to Melbourne and then the return flight on Monday morning. Easy, smooth and a great start and finish to a weekend away. Fly Corporate’s website makes booking simple. Online check in works smoothly and bag drop off is simple. The plane departed on time and the in flight service was friendly and charming. Substituting items was not a problem and nothing was too much trouble. We arrived in Melbourne slightly early and we were farewelled with charm and encouraged to fly with them again. Remember you are flying in a SAAB so headroom in the aisle is tight if you are tall. Legroom is sufficient for people of average height people so if you are taller book an exit row seat.
reviews.author: lgecc

reviews.title: Simple and friendly way to fly
reviews.text: My husband and I flew with Fly Corporate from Wollongong to Brisbane and returned with them a few days later. It was an excellent experience! We were checked in and ready to board the aircraft only 30 minutes after leaving home, with our car parked in secure long term parking. So easy! It was such a joy not to have to deal with Sydney traffic chokes and interminable airport queues. Corporate staff were so friendly and helpful. The on board snacks were very suitable and at no extra cost. We enjoyed this experience so much we are now planning to do a similar trip with Corporate to Melbourne. I am thinking that people living in Western Sydney- eg Campbelltown and Camden - May find it far easier to fly with Corporate from Albion Park than to bother with Sydney Airport. Also, I am thinking that for my next international trip, I might book from Melbourne or Brisbane and Fly Corporate to those airports prior to the international departure. Anything to avoid the horror of travelling by car through Sydney. Well done and thank you, Corporate.
reviews.author: dmmcconnachie

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: From the care and attention at booking in, the individual attention during the flight. Nothing was too much trouble. A very comfortable flight then personal care when alightening. Absolutely well worth using this service over the larfer commercial airlines,
reviews.author: Joii

reviews.title: A quick trip to Biloela
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Brisbane as I had an audit to perform in Biloela. I was a little nervous about the deal at first as I’ve never booked with a small airline. Usually I book either the larger commercial airlines but this paid off in spades. Comfortable, reliable and just great overall service and convenience. A great flight!
reviews.author: Chris T

reviews.title: Best customer service when you need it, far better than the big airlines!
reviews.text: The team went WELL above and beyond in being flexible to an unexpected circumstance in my booking, far more flexible than they needed to be. The staff were even responding after-hours, demonstrates they are proud and live their values. I look forward to using Fly Corporate in future, they've won my loyalty. Jason
reviews.author: Jason W

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: When flying to regional locations in Australia I recommend Fly Corporate. Friendly staff and competitive prices
reviews.author: Daemien_D

reviews.title: Quick and efficient
reviews.text: For business this was an economical way to attend a meeting in Brisbane and be back the same day. The return flight was 15 minutes early and all stages of the flight from booking in to arrival were well done.
reviews.author: MyTYT

reviews.title: Convenient and great service
reviews.text: I've flown between Wollongong and Essendon three times now, and it's been great. Not only do you avoid the trip to Sydney Airport, arriving in Essendon means no queues or hassles at that end and a much quicker trip to and from Melbourne CBD as well. The convenience alone would be enough for me to give them a 5 star rating, but the friendly and welcoming staff go out of their way to make the whole flight a great experience too. They even serve snacks on all flights and beer & wine on evening flights.
reviews.author: Brett P

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: This was my first flight with Fly Corporate and my expectations were exceeded. Although I was slightly anxious when I seen the size of the aircraft the flight attendant / co-pilot and pilot were lovely and thoroughly explained the safety steps and different noises we might hear whilst flying (a beeping sound) and that it was totally normal and nothing to be concerned about. Inside the cabin was quite tight and the flight is a little noisy but a small snack was offered which was nice considering some of the larger flights do not offer this without charge. I was also able to choose my seat allocation on web check-in which did not attract an extra fee. No in flight entertainment was available. For a quick flight it was such a convenient direct service. Would highly recommend and will use this service again.
reviews.author: Coddiwomple_Travellers

reviews.title: Convenient  Flight
reviews.text: We found it punctual & convenient to travel with Fly Corporate. The staff are amazing. My only problem is I found the small plane much noisier than the bigger ones to travel in but it sure beat driving all the way up to Sydney.
reviews.author: Nola G

reviews.title: Flights with Corporate
reviews.text: Unfortunately the flight was 2 hrs late leaving Inverell due to late arrival from Sydney. Landing spot at Brisbane was lost and we had to wait for another to become vacant. I felt for the crew as there was nothing they could do. All on board were very grateful for bottled water and snack offered as there is no food available at airport. Also grateful to be able to leave plane while waiting as plane does not have a toilet!! The flight was a little scary due to rain, turbulence and darkness!!! Perhaps next time I will think twice about flying in the afternoon!!! Ten out of ten for crew though they did a sterling job
reviews.author: Janet C

reviews.title: Top service
reviews.text: What a service well organise friendly hostress and no hassles will be using this service again. With surprise we were given beverages and a small snack. The seating configuration was very comfortable with plenty of leg room.
reviews.author: hajaka2017
